Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the initial web results and incorrectly asserted that WebSurfer had found “Pine Springs, Minnesota” in Washington County, then inferred the county seat as Stillwater. The visible search results actually highlighted Pine Springs, Texas in Culberson County. This premature and incorrect disambiguation could have led to the wrong county seat if not corrected later.
